title: Rules for the calculation and verification of recycled content in plastic packaging

triage.reason: Commission feedback/consultation on a planned implementing act setting uniform rules for calculating and verifying recycled content in plastic packaging under the PPWR closed on 16 September 2026, a current development within the last 60 days.

draft.summary: The feedback period for the planned implementing act on rules for the calculation and verification of recycled content in plastic packaging ran from 14 August 2026 to 16 September 2026.
